# One command per line; pushing a change to this file runs them on Modal via GitHub Actions.
# run 17b: azure end to end again from its run 16a raw outputs, recomposed on CPU with stage 1b QA 0.12.0 (no engine run again);
# plus a stage-1b-only draw of more FASHN skirt backs. Stage 1b QA 0.12.0; no existing threshold changed.
# Why azure: 0.12.0 leaves out the cut tie string hanging below the back hem (49 px, rows 527-539, columns 157-162).
#   The recompose prints it as a stage 1b WARNING and records it in summary.warnings (a trim is never silent).
#   That string was the seed of run 16b's cream flap (turntable_b frames 84-159, hem girth +6.4 cm).
#   turntable_a is pinned to the back still at its last frame, and 16b's turntable_a shows the string too (frames 40-80).
#   The back still changes by those 49 px only. The front is pixel-identical to 16b (its hem differs from run 15's by 0-1 rows).
#   Same stage 2 seeds (43/44/45), control and prompt as 16b and run 15, so the run isolates the effect of the back still.
#   Open question this run tests: the see-through lower-skirt panel in turntable_a 32-56 (on the side of the string).
#   If it stays with the string gone, it is stage 2's and stays open; 17b then is not a panel-clean bundle.
# --dress-expect pins the reviewed pixels (decoded RGB, same hash with numpy 2.2.6 / Pillow 11.3.0 as in the Modal image).
#   front d4cbc556b400eeb9... (unchanged), back c3e193ed8e5ddad9... (0.12.0).
#   A different hash stops the run before stage 2.
# Before copying the 17b artifact back: copy the local spikes/garment-engine/out/phase0/azure-palm-baby-doll-dress (the committed 16b
#   bundle) to azure-palm-baby-doll-dress-run16b, so 16b vs 17b can be compared.
# Why the skirt is NOT end to end yet: the 17a pair (front fashn@44, kept back fashn@43) passes QA but disagrees twice by eye:
#   the kept back has no pink smocked waistband (the front and the shop back have one; no check measures the band), and
#   the tier seam sits about 38 px (about 10 cm) higher on the back than on the front.
#   Back fashn@44 has the band and a matching seam, but misses torso cover 0.9156 < 0.92; the threshold is not loosened.
#   This line keeps the reviewed front and the 17a back and draws 8 more FASHN backs.
#   Both keeps resolve in run 17a's stage1b/ (checked on a copy of the artifact; they reproduce 8909a1c0... / a1263fc2...).
#   17a moves into stage1b/history/ on the Volume. fashn@43 is kept only as the scored reference, not as a back to pin.
# Cost estimate (H100 list price $3.95/h; not the invoice):
#   azure stage 2 + stage 4 about $1.6-1.7 (run 16b: 1,503 GPU s = $1.65, plus container load); the CPU recompose under a cent.
#   skirt 8 FASHN draws plus load about 100-150 GPU s, about $0.1-0.17; CPU prepare and finalize under a cent each.
#   About $1.8 in all, at most about $1.9.
# Order: every export (no GPU) runs before the first GPU command.
# Each modal line ends in || echo ::warning:: so one failed product does not skip the other.
# No --accept-failed-dress.
# Review before 17c:
#   azure: turntable_a frames 32-80 (panel, string) and turntable_b 80-160 (flap); hem girth back near run 15's 149.5 cm;
#          compare with azure-palm-baby-doll-dress-run16b and -run15.
#   skirt: the pairs table and candidates/stills/. Pin a back that passes, HAS the pink smocked waistband, and has its tier seam
#          at about 0.63 of the length (front about row 590), all by eye; then 17c end to end with --recompose-dress
#          --dress-pin front=fashn@44,back=fashn@<seed> --dress-expect <reviewed hashes>, about $1.6-1.7.
pnpm build:packages
pnpm --filter @curtain/garment-spike shop:bohohippychic -- --fetch-images
git diff --exit-code -- spikes/garment-engine/data/bohohippychic/images.json spikes/garment-engine/data/bohohippychic/products.json
pnpm --filter @curtain/garment-spike export:phase0 -- --shop bohohippychic --product azure-palm-baby-doll-dress
pnpm --filter @curtain/garment-spike export:phase0 -- --shop bohohippychic --product crimson-wildflower-maxi-skirt
modal run spikes/garment-engine/modal/run_phase0.py --job-dir spikes/garment-engine/out/phase0/azure-palm-baby-doll-dress --recompose-dress --dress-pin front=fashn,back=fashn --dress-expect front=d4cbc556b400eeb9c145f9c1,back=c3e193ed8e5ddad9dce267fd --no-synthetic-recon || echo "::warning::azure-palm-baby-doll-dress: run 17b failed"
modal run spikes/garment-engine/modal/run_phase0.py --job-dir spikes/garment-engine/out/phase0/crimson-wildflower-maxi-skirt --dress --dress-only --dress-draws "front=keep:fashn@44;back=keep:fashn@43,fashn@46-53" --no-synthetic-recon || echo "::warning::crimson-wildflower-maxi-skirt: run 17b stage 1b (more backs) failed"
# Not in 17b:
#   skirt end to end: no back yet with both the waistband and a matching seam (the fallback pin of fashn@43 is withdrawn).
#   blouse: needs a longer proxy (exporter, founder's call).
#   cardigan: needs the outerwear proxy decision; the back sleeves are still swapped under prompt 0.2.0.
#   palazzo: still waits for sign-off on Qwen's pocket flap and darker print.
